summary.zh-CN: 可以在会话中管理定时任务、查看模型调用与 Token 用量，并在切换页面或长回复时保留准确的阅读位置。
summary.en-US: Manage scheduled tasks and inspect model calls and token usage in a session, while keeping your reading position across views and long replies.

body.zh-CN: 在会话中启用、暂停、立即运行、查看详情或删除定时任务；较长的任务内容会保持紧凑显示。
body.en-US: Enable, pause, run now, inspect, or delete scheduled tasks directly in a session while keeping long task content compact.

title.zh-CN: 模型调用与 Token 用量

body.zh-CN: 会话工作台会显示 Agent 轮次、模型调用次数、已报告调用次数和按模型统计的 Token 用量。
body.en-US: The session workspace shows agent turns, model calls, reported calls, and token usage by model.

body.zh-CN: 在工作区、会话和常用页面之间切换后，会回到此前的位置；Markdown 文件在切换文件和预览模式时也会保留滚动位置。
body.en-US: Return to the previous position after switching workspaces, sessions, and common pages. Markdown previews also retain their scroll position when changing files or preview modes.

title.en-US: Faster access to large session lists

body.zh-CN: 会话列表使用分页、排序和预取来减少卡顿，在大量历史和工具调用并存时仍可继续浏览全部会话。
body.en-US: Pagination, sorting, and prefetching reduce stalls so you can continue browsing all sessions even with extensive history and tool calls.

title.zh-CN: 上下文压缩提示的位置

body.zh-CN: 长回复仍在恢复时，上下文压缩提示只会在能够定位到正确回复位置后显示，不再堆叠到会话末尾。
body.en-US: While a long reply is still restoring, context-compaction markers appear only after their correct reply position is known instead of stacking at the end of the session.
